def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    print("Active doc:", doc.name)
    products = doc.products
    for i in range(products.count):
        p = products.item(i)
        print("Product:", p.productType)
    # Design info
    design = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    if design:
        root = design.rootComponent
        print("Root comp:", root.name)
        print("Bodies:", root.bRepBodies.count)
        for b in root.bRepBodies:
            bb = b.boundingBox
            mn = bb.minPoint; mx = bb.maxPoint
            print(f"  Body {b.name}: min({mn.x*10:.2f},{mn.y*10:.2f},{mn.z*10:.2f}) max({mx.x*10:.2f},{mx.y*10:.2f},{mx.z*10:.2f})")
    # CAM info
    cam = adsk.cam.CAM.cast(products.itemByProductType('CAMProductType'))
    if cam:
        print("Setups:", cam.setups.count)
        for s in cam.setups:
            print("  Setup:", s.name, "opType:", s.operationType, "ops:", s.operations.count)
    return "done"

def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    design = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(app.activeProduct if app.activeProduct.productType=='DesignProductType' else app.activeDocument.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    root = design.rootComponent
    body = root.bRepBodies.item(0)
    print("Faces:", body.faces.count)
    # Classify faces
    planar_z = {}
    cyls = []
    for i,f in enumerate(body.faces):
        geo = f.geometry
        st = f.geometry.surfaceType
        bb = f.boundingBox
        if st == adsk.core.SurfaceTypes.PlaneSurfaceType:
            n = geo.normal
            # only near-vertical (facing +/-Z)
            if abs(n.z) > 0.99:
                z = round(bb.maxPoint.z*10,3)
                planar_z.setdefault(z, 0)
                planar_z[z]+=1
        elif st == adsk.core.SurfaceTypes.CylinderSurfaceType:
            r = geo.radius*10
            cyls.append((round(r,3), round(bb.minPoint.z*10,2), round(bb.maxPoint.z*10,2),
                         round(f.centroid.x*10,2), round(f.centroid.y*10,2)))
    print("Horizontal planar face Z levels (Z-facing): count per level")
    for z in sorted(planar_z):
        print(f"  Z={z} mm : {planar_z[z]} faces")
    print("Cylinders (r, zmin, zmax, cx, cy):")
    for c in sorted(set(cyls)):
        print("  ", c)
    return "done"

def run(_context):

    setup = cam.setups.item(0)
    print("Setup:", setup.name)
    # WCS
    try:
        orient = setup.parameters.itemByName('wcs_orientation')
    except: pass
    for p in setup.parameters:
        try:
            print("  param:", p.name, "=", p.expression if hasattr(p,'expression') else p.value)
        except Exception as e:
            pass
    return "done"

def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    doc = app.activeDocument
    cam = adsk.cam.CAM.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('CAMProductType'))
    setup = cam.setups.item(0)
    # Get WCS transform
    try:
        m = setup.wcsTransform  # matrix3d, WCS to model? 
        print("wcsTransform:")
        a = m.asArray()
        for r in range(4):
            print("  ", [round(a[r*4+c],4) for c in range(4)])
    except Exception as e:
        print("no wcsTransform", e)
    # models
    for mdl in setup.models:
        print("model:", mdl.name)
    return "done"

def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    design = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(app.activeDocument.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    body = design.rootComponent.bRepBodies.item(0)
    # WCS_Z = design_Z - 25.77 (mm), so top of stock WCS0 -> design_Z=25.77
    def wz(dz): return dz - 25.77
    # planar faces facing +Z (design), any orientation
    print("=== All planar faces, grouped by normal direction ===")
    from collections import defaultdict
    groups = defaultdict(list)
    for f in body.faces:
        geo = f.geometry
        if geo.surfaceType != adsk.core.SurfaceTypes.PlaneSurfaceType: continue
        n = geo.normal
        key = (round(n.x,2),round(n.y,2),round(n.z,2))
        c = f.centroid
        groups[key].append((round(f.area*100,1), round(c.x*10,2),round(c.y*10,2),round(c.z*10,2), round(wz(c.z*10),2)))
    for k in sorted(groups):
        print("normal",k, "->", len(groups[k]),"faces")
        for item in sorted(groups[k], key=lambda t:-t[0])[:12]:
            print("     area",item[0],"mm2 centroid(dx,dy,dz)=",item[1],item[2],item[3]," WCSz=",item[4])
    return "done"

def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    design = adsk.fusion.Design.cast(app.activeDocument.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
    body = design.rootComponent.bRepBodies.item(0)
    # design-Y is machining-up direction. Report distinct Y levels of planar faces normal to +/-Y
    from collections import Counter
    ylevels = Counter()
    for f in body.faces:
        geo=f.geometry
        if geo.surfaceType!=adsk.core.SurfaceTypes.PlaneSurfaceType: continue
        n=geo.normal
        if abs(n.y)>0.99:
            ylevels[round(f.centroid.y*10,2)] += 1
    print("Design-Y planar levels (machining-up), count:")
    for y in sorted(ylevels, reverse=True):
        print(f"  Y={y}mm : {ylevels[y]} faces")
    # bottom face design-Y min
    print("Body Y range:", round(body.boundingBox.minPoint.y*10,2), round(body.boundingBox.maxPoint.y*10,2))
    return "done"

def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    cam = adsk.cam.CAM.cast(app.activeDocument.products.itemByProductType('CAMProductType'))
    setup = cam.setups.item(0)
    libMgr = adsk.cam.CAMManager.get().libraryManager
    from adsk.core import URL
    lib = libMgr.toolLibraries.toolLibraryAtURL(URL.create("toollibraryroot://Local/TIW CNC Tool Library (4-28-26)"))
    def tool_by_num(n):
        for i in range(lib.count):
            t=lib.item(i)
            p=t.parameters.itemByName('tool_number')
            if p and p.value.value==n: return t
        return None
    faceTool = tool_by_num(1)   # 3/4" flat
    print("faceTool:", faceTool.parameters.itemByName('tool_description').value.value)
    # create face op
    inp = setup.operations.createInput('face')
    inp.tool = faceTool
    inp.displayName = 'Face Top'
    op = setup.operations.add(inp)
    print("created face op:", op.name)
    # list its parameters we may want
    for pn in ['tool_stepover','tool_diameter','stockToLeave','bottomHeight','clearanceHeight']:
        try:
            pr=op.parameters.itemByName(pn)
            print("  ",pn,"=",pr.expression)
        except Exception as e:
            print("  ",pn,"missing")
    return "done"

            t=lib.item(i)
            p=t.parameters.itemByName('tool_number')
            if p and p.value.value==n: return t
        return None
    finTool = tool_by_num(3)   # 1/2" flat for vertical walls (contour)

    inp2.tool = ballTool
    inp2.displayName = 'Scallop Finish'
    op2 = setup.operations.add(inp2)

def run(_context):
    import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, adsk.cam, time
    app = adsk.core.Application.get()
    cam = adsk.cam.CAM.cast(app.activeDocument.products.itemByProductType('CAMProductType'))
    setup = cam.setups.item(0)
    # generate all
    future = cam.generateAllToolpaths(False)
    # wait for completion
    import adsk
    while not future.isGenerationCompleted:
        adsk.doEvents()
        time.sleep(0.2)
    print("Generation complete.")
    for o in setup.operations:
        try:
            hasTP = o.hasToolpath
        except: hasTP='?'
        print(f"  {o.name}: hasToolpath={hasTP}")
    return "done"
